# API Template

Use this structure in `services/<service-name>/api.md`. Link to OpenAPI/Swagger instead of duplicating a full specification.

```markdown
# API Documentation

## Overview

<!-- Describe the APIs exposed by this service. -->

## Authentication

<!-- Describe authentication requirements. -->

## API Groups

| Group | Description |
|---|---|
| [Group] | [Description] |

## Request Standards

<!-- Describe common request conventions. -->

## Response Standards

<!-- Describe common response conventions. -->

## Error Handling

<!-- Describe error response format. -->

## Detailed API Reference

<!-- Link to OpenAPI/Swagger documentation if available. -->
```
